company.shortDescription: Express Building arranges bridge financing solutions for small and medium residential property developers.
company.description: Express Building arranges financing solutions for residential property developers. The company focuses on short-term bridge financing that covers construction costs and bridges delays between mortgage approval and bank loan disbursement. Its Express Building Financing product provides unsecured or secured developer bridge loans, typically with interest-only payments until maturity. Use cases include built homes facing bank mortgage disbursement delays and homes to be built that require 100% construction funding for pre-sold units with preapproved mortgages. Express Building operates as a broker or consultant working with partner lenders and developers to structure these loans. Its services support the expansion of pre-sold housing development pipelines.
